entity.summary: Open-source non-custodial Bitcoin wallet ecosystem from UniSat for BTC and newer Bitcoin asset standards across browser and mobile surfaces.
entity.notes: Current UniSat first-party documentation explicitly describes UniSat Wallet as open-source and non-custodial and distinguishes the wallet from UniSat Marketplace, Inscribe and other services. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: UniSat open-source non-custodial Bitcoin browser-extension wallet.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension runtime only; iOS and Android wallet applications are deferred.
